text:
ashley: Heads-up: new reranker r2.3 onboard looks odd — NDCG@10 +0.017 overall but MRR@10 -0.038 on short queries (<8 tokens). Ran per-slice; dip concentrated on short queries.

matt: Interesting. Did you compare webqa-v2-holdout vs anchorset-2026?

ashley: Yes. webqa-v2 shows improvement, anchorset-2026 shows MRR drop. Short-query slice (qlen<=7) is the offender.

jin: Could be pad-side or priming token count. What quant/config did you run?

ashley: Baseline is fp16. We tested PTQ int8 too. Int8 NDCG roughly matches fp16, but the MRR gap exists in fp16 as well — so not purely quantization.

sara: Can you paste slice stats + one example query+cand pair?

ashley: Sure — snippet:
```
slice: short_queries (qlen<=7)
samples: 12,384
NDCG@10 delta: +0.017
MRR@10 delta: -0.038
top1 delta: -4.1%

example query: "how to reset wifi on my router"
top candidate (gold): "factory reset steps for model X"
model top1: "troubleshooting connectivity issues"
``` 

matt: Try rerun with `candidate_limit=100`, `pad_mode=right` and `seed=42`. Also print tokenized lengths for query+candidate.

ashley: Running now, logs to `/eval/runs/2026-03-21/1756501234`. Quick note: we prepend `Q:` in priming — that could shift token counts for very short queries.

jin: Remove `Q:` or test without priming as one experiment.

sara: Also compute top1 accuracy alongside MRR — MRR can hide worst-top1 regressions if top5 improves.

ashley: I grabbed top1/top5: shortquery top1 delta -4.1%, top5 +1.8% — aligns with reorder vs recall tradeoff.

matt: :thumbsup: plan two quick experiments: (A) strip `Q:` prefix; (B) force `pad_mode=left` to 32 tokens. Share numbers here.

ashley: Will run both; ETA ~20m. If fix found, we should: 1) add priming guard; 2) include short-query calibration set in CI; 3) pin quant/config that preserves prefix semantics.

eval-bot: Eval finished — results:
```
experiment A (no Q:): shortquery_top1_delta = -3.9%
experiment B (left-pad 32): shortquery_top1_delta = -0.6%
NDCG@10: A +0.010, B +0.012
results json: /eval/runs/2026-03-21/1756501234/results.json
```

sara: Left-pad wins. Proposal: set `pad_mode=left` as default for rerank bringups and add a short-query calibration assertion in CI.

matt: Agreed. Also add a smoke assertion in ranker_harness: `top1_delta_on_short_queries > -1%` or fail.

ashley: I'll open a PR with harness changes + config tweak, assigning to @matt for review.

matt: Thanks — please include the example that failed as a regression test.

sara: Nice triage team. :rocket:
